episodes.synopsis: Fushi, having spent several decades alone on an island, learns that a village was attacked by the Nokkers.
episodes.title: Infatuation Reborn

episodes.synopsis: Things do not go well when Tonari tries to remove the Nokker from Hisame's arm.
episodes.title: Beating Will

episodes.synopsis: Kahaku, the sixth of Hayase's descendants, introduces himself to Fushi. Much time has passed, and the Guardians have expanded their influence.
episodes.title: The Awaited

episodes.synopsis: Fushi must stay on the move in order to keep the Nokkers from attacking, so Prince Bon accompanies him out of the castle town.
episodes.title: The Young Man Who Can See

episodes.synopsis: Fushi, along with Kahaku, Bon and Bon's army, travel through several towns, spreading word of the Nokkers along the way.
episodes.title: The Holy Man's Voyage

episodes.synopsis: Kahaku asks Fushi to marry him. He seems confident that they can overcome the complications of Fushi being a shape-shifting immortal, but Fushi isn’t. Cylira returns.
episodes.title: Heretics Betrayed

episodes.synopsis: Fushi attempts to escape from his iron cell, while Bon and Todo await their trial in their own cells.
episodes.title: Crime and Forgiveness

episodes.synopsis: The Kingdom of Ularis, along with Fushi, Todo, Bon's family, and Baron Spring Roll, prepare for life without Bon.
episodes.title: Beyond Dreams

episodes.synopsis: As warned by Kahaku’s arm, the Nokkers attack the head church of the Church of Bennett, causing terrible devastation.
episodes.title: Expanding Consciousness

episodes.synopsis: Fushi trains his senses in preparation for the Nokkers’ attack on Renril. He discovers a strange girl in a circus tent.
episodes.title: Resonance

episodes.synopsis: Having finished training on the derelict ship, Fushi travels to Renril, where the Nokkers are threatening to attack.
episodes.title: The Value of Flesh

episodes.synopsis: Fushi and his allies work to win over the trust of the people of Renril in preparation for the Nokkers’ attack.
episodes.title: Secret Behind the Veil

episodes.synopsis: The team works to prevent the Nokkers from making use of the waterways and sewers. Fushi works non-stop rebuilding all the homes, and the exhaustion begins to show.
episodes.title: The Wise Man's Identity

episodes.synopsis: The city of Renril bands together around Fushi in preparation for the Nokkers’ attack. The princess introduces him to her father, King Boldron of Sonia.
episodes.title: Morning of Rebirth

episodes.synopsis: Fushi fends off the Nokkers miles away from Renril, but the Nokkers had already devised a more cunning plan.
episodes.title: The Self, Worn Down

episodes.synopsis: The death of his three friends turns Fushi mad, and he begins defeating the Nokkers at a furious pace. But as it turns out, he may not be the only immortal.
episodes.title: Three Eternal Warriors

episodes.synopsis: Amidst the brutal battle against the Nokkers, Bon and Kahaku both share a desire to protect Fushi’s humanity. How they go about it, however, puts them at odds.
episodes.title: What You Want to Protect

episodes.synopsis: March begins her desperate search for Fushi, whose absence has led to the city being overrun by the Nokkers.
episodes.title: Death of the Deathless

episodes.synopsis: In the beginning, it was an orb. And Fushi was an orb once again. But though there was no certainty, there was hope.
episodes.title: And Then, Dawn

episodes.synopsis: With the Nokkers defeated, the people of Renril rejoice, and Fushi and his friends discuss their hopes for the future.
episodes.title: End of an Era
